request.style: English, male solo with choir, organ, cello, harp, flute, timpani, solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Uzai raised up a son called Hananiah
He joined the men to build up the wall
The gates were set and the bars were placed
We worked in the dust as we heard it called

[Verse]
Uzai the goldsmith worked with care
Hananiah the perfumer stood there
They restored the wall to the Broad Wall side
Next to Rephaiah and the people who stayed

[Verse]
Sanballat and Tobiah were furious
The Ammonites and Arabs were furious
They conspired to throw it into confusion
But we posted a guard day and night

[Verse]
The laborers said our strength is failing
Too much rubble and we cannot rebuild
But we prayed to our God and we warned
We kept working though our enemies were stern

[Verse]
The wall was finished in fifty-two days
The nations around us were afraid
Uzai’s son helped close up the gaps
We finished the work of the city walls
